units.source_text: 偶尔客人喝多了酒，想对她做点过分的举动，金花都如此拒绝，甚至给客人自己得病的证据。

en.t: Sometimes, when a client drank too much and tried to make improper advances toward her, Jinhua would refuse him in this way, even showing the client proof that she herself was ill.

units.source_text: 慢慢的，客人不再来找她了，

en.t: Gradually, clients stopped coming to see her,

units.source_text: 与此同时，她的生计也越来越窘迫。

en.t: and at the same time, her livelihood grew more and more difficult.
